Harold Holt dive pool

The dive pool is available for bookings and deep-water aqua classes.

Please note that the dive tower will not come back into service but will remain as a monument to a bygone era. New one and three-metre springboards will ensure plunging in from a diving board is still very much part of the dive pool.

**From 1st December 2025 until 27 March 2026, the dive pool is open 4-7pm weekdays and 1-6pm weekends. Availability subject to private bookings.  

**From 27 March to 30 November, the dive pool will be closed and will only open for bookings or on days when the temperature exceeds 28°C. From 1 December 2026, the dive pool will reopen for the summer season. 

Please note that when the dive pool is open to the public, it is for diving only and cannot be used for any other activities. If you would like to use the dive pool for scuba diving or freediving, a booking is required.

Harold Holt leisure pool and splash pad for kids

 The leisure pool is open:

  • Monday to Thursday: 5:45 am to 8:45 pm

  • Friday: 5:45 am to 7:45 pm

  • Saturday: 6 am to 6:45 pm

  • Sunday: 7 am to 6:45 pm

Hours may differ on public holidays. At certain times, part of the pool is reserved for lessons, bookings or the pool maybe closed for cleaning.

Harold Holt splash pad

The outdoor splash pad is open on warmer days, please call reception before your visit to confirm.

You must follow the Watch Around Water policy when visiting our pools with children.

Harold Holt school carnival pool closures

Area closed: indoor 25m pool including surrounding area and seating. Warm water (hydro) pool will remain open.
